# M S Arun Sanjeev

> Personal portfolio of M S Arun Sanjeev — also written Arun Sanjeev or ARUN SANJEEV, and known online as msarunsanjeev and arunsanjeevms. A Software Developer and Full Stack Developer based in Namakkal, Tamil Nadu, India, working across full stack development, cloud deployment, cyber security and Generative AI. Final-year Computer Science and Engineering student at M. Kumarasamy College of Engineering, Karur.

The site is a single page at https://arunsanjeev.dev/. Sections are tabs on that
page and are addressable by URL fragment; every fragment below is a stable,
linkable location. All section content is present in the initial HTML response,
so no JavaScript execution is required to read it. Only the Blog tab is filled
in at runtime from an external Medium feed.

Canonical URL: https://arunsanjeev.dev/
All other hostnames (www, http, the github.io origin) 301-redirect here.
